bias.label: Testing the 3,651 cap; a close above opens 3,690-3,697

event: Today, Fri 27 Nov: US half-day (stocks close 20:00 SAST), thin trade. Sun 29 Nov: OPEC+ meeting. Mon 30 Nov: month end. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report, 15:30 SAST. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST (time UNVERIFIED), with a 25 bp hike widely expected.

bullets.title: Rally held overnight
bullets.text: Spot gold was 3,650 at 08:45 SAST, up about 2.3% on the day, after bouncing from the 15-month low near 3,446 on Wednesday (FinanceFeeds, Swissquote bid).

bullets.title: Dollar a bit softer
bullets.text: The dollar index slipped below 103.70 in thin Black Friday trade while US stock futures rallied (Finscans, from FXStreet).

bullets.title: Yields still rising
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield rose to about 4.92%, which works against gold and makes this bounce less secure (FinanceFeeds).

bullets.title: Hike still priced
bullets.text: Fed futures price about a 99% chance of a 25 bp hike on 9 December after core PCE came in at 3.3%, so the bigger pressure on gold has not gone.

bullets.title: China keeps buying
bullets.text: China's central bank added gold for a 24th straight month and Hong Kong gold exports to China rose to a six-month high in October (FXEmpire).

bullets.title: At the decision level
bullets.text: Price is sitting right at 3,651, the Fibonacci level and the top of this week's range, where the bounce either breaks out or fails.

buy.title: Buy plan: pullback to 3,595-3,606 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is still against the bigger downtrend from 17 Nov, so use half size or skip it.
A slow pullback into 3,595-3,606 with long lower wicks, not a fast drop through it.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,615.
The dollar index staying under 103.70 and US yields easing.
Take some profit at 3,640 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying now at 3,650, right at resistance. Wait for the pullback or a clean breakout.
A 1H close under 3,583 means the bounce has failed and 3,565 is next. Step aside.
Today's half-day US trade can spike price through stops. Keep size small.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That turns a small loss into a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rally fails at 3,689-3,706 (with the main trend)
look: Price breaks 3,651 and pushes into 3,689-3,706, then stalls near Monday's high.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,680.
A 1H lower high under 3,706 with momentum fading.
The dollar or US yields firming again, which fits the Fed hike pricing.
Take some profit at 3,655 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 3,650 just because it is resistance. Wait for the test of 3,689-3,706 and a rejection.
A 1H close above 3,710 means the bounce is stronger and 3,738-3,792 is next. Do not fight it.
Fed, tariff or Middle East headlines can move price fast in thin holiday trade.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
